gateAndPayability.assertion: No payable attempt and no gateway order were created. Every probe was refused at customer_auth, which runs before any Wix call, any readiness evaluation and any DynamoDB write.
gateAndPayability.honestLimitation: PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED was NOT reached by any probe, and cannot be reached by one. `handler.handler` calls customer_auth.require_customer FIRST, so an unauthenticated request returns 401 and never enters _create. Even with a valid customer token, _create evaluates payment_readiness BEFORE the initiation gate, and both EXPECTED_* inputs are empty, so readiness returns CONFIGURATION_UNVERIFIED -> 409 payment_unavailable, which short-circuits ahead of the PAYMENT_INITIATION_DISABLED branch. The measured live contract change is 404 -> 401. See docs/execution/checkout-deployment-20261001.md.
